_readme: Multi-hop recall prompts for the J-Lens causal-faithfulness study. Each item: an indirect clue whose HIDDEN intermediate entity must be recalled to produce the answer (the intermediate is never stated). 'answer' is the intended next token. cf_* is a same-category counterfactual used for the swap. 'expect_linsim' is a design guess for cos(unembed(answer),unembed(entity)); the CODE MEASURES the real value per item and uses it as the x-axis. Three families give a HIGH->LOW linsim spread with reliable single-token answers a 4B knows: capital (high), currency (mid/low), animal-sound (very low). Every item is verified zero-shot; failures are dropped. Scoring uses the first content token of each label.

families.sound: animal -> the sound it makes (VERY LOW linsim: sound not linearly readable from animal)
